learningObjectives: Save, open and close an API Scan project using documented Home-menu commands.
Distinguish project persistence from loading or saving the current payload.
Duplicate, delete and rename documented project objects without assuming an unverified recovery mechanism.
Use an independent naming convention while setting actual TestCase execution order separately.

elements.description: Save as saves an API Scan project to a chosen file; Save or Ctrl+S saves to the same file after it has been saved before. Open opens a project and Close closes the current project. These are project operations, distinct from Payload-tab file operations and export to Commander.

elements.title: What Save/Open/Close actually do
items: Use Save as to choose a project filename and explicitly save checkpoints before risky edits.
Use Open to reopen a saved API Scan project; only the saved contents are a dependable recovery point.
Close closes the project. The accessed current documentation does not guarantee autosave on window close, automatic reopening, or a specific save-prompt sequence.
Payload Save writes the current payload to a file; Payload Load reads a new payload. Existing payload content is replaced when loading or adding a payload file.
Saving an API Scan project is not automatically equivalent to exporting API Modules, generating a Tosca subset or creating a workspace template.

elements.text: Keep project and payload backups distinct. A payload file is not a complete message backup of headers, authentication and transport settings, nor a full project backup. Use the documented export workflow for Commander artifacts.

bulletPoints: Independent guidance: use a controlled backup location and explicit checkpoints before destructive edits.
Payload Save/Load manages payload content, not every setting of a message or the whole project.

elements.description: Duplicate copies the selected folder or message; it is also available in the context menu. Inspect the copy and rename it deliberately; the accessed article does not certify an incrementing-name algorithm or exact destination for every object type.
Delete removes the selected folder or message. Confirm the intended selection and save a recoverable checkpoint before deletion.

elements.text: The accessed docs do not establish a universal Undo/recovery policy for API Scan. Do not depend on an unverified shortcut, automatic archive or autosave; preserve an explicit checkpoint before deleting data.

elements.description: Use Rename in the Home menu or the context menu of the selected project object. The accessed API Scan pages do not verify an F2 shortcut; a Commander shortcut list is not proof of API Scan behavior.

An optional 01 / 02 / 03 prefix can communicate intended sequence to reviewers. Do not assume display sorting defines TestCase execution order; inspect and configure the exported test steps separately. The accessed docs do not establish universal alphabetical sorting of every object.

bulletPoints: Keep recoverable checkpoints before deletion; do not infer recovery from unsupported UI shortcuts.
Names document intent; actual test-step ordering still needs inspection.

elements.text: Save a small project, save one payload separately, duplicate and rename a message, then inspect what each saved artifact contains. Load only a disposable payload because loading replaces current content. Academy video/exercise files require access and have not been verified.

examPitfalls.title: Treating payload persistence as a complete message backup
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming Payload Save also preserves all project objects, headers and transport settings.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Payload Save/Load handles the payload. Home-menu project saving preserves the project; export is a separate workflow.

examPitfalls.title: Assuming automatic recovery after destructive edits
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Depending on an unverified Undo, autosave or deleted-object archive.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Save an explicit recoverable checkpoint before deletion; the accessed docs do not guarantee those recovery mechanisms.

examPitfalls.title: Treating numerical names as execution scheduling
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming 01/02 names automatically control exported TestCase order.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Use prefixes as an independent readability convention; inspect and configure the actual test-step order separately.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A tester wants to save only the current payload content to a file, rather than the whole API Scan project. Which control is documented?

options.text: Save in the Payload tab (Load reads a replacement payload).
Individual payload content cannot be saved.

practiceQuiz.hint: Distinguish the data body from project persistence.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Payload Save writes payload content and Load replaces it from file. It does not save all message settings or the project.

optionExplanations.A: These controls manage the project rather than only the payload.
optionExplanations.B: This is the documented payload-file workflow; Load replaces current payload content.
optionExplanations.C: Duplicate copies an object instead of writing a payload file.
optionExplanations.D: The payload article explicitly supports Save to file.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Before deleting a message, which independent precaution provides a dependable recovery point without assuming an unverified Undo policy?

options.text: Assume Ctrl+Z always restores every deleted object.
Explicitly save a recoverable project checkpoint before deleting.
Assume a universal Restore command exists.
Assume deleted objects are automatically archived for 24 hours.

practiceQuiz.hint: Protect the state before making the destructive edit.
practiceQuiz.rationale: An explicit saved checkpoint preserves a known state. The accessed API Scan documentation does not certify automatic archives or every recovery shortcut.

optionExplanations.A: The accessed sources do not guarantee this shortcut for every deleted object.
optionExplanations.B: A saved checkpoint gives a known recovery state; unsaved later edits are not included.
optionExplanations.C: A universal Restore command was not established.
optionExplanations.D: A 24-hour automatic deletion archive was not established.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Why might a team use optional numerical prefixes such as 01 and 02 in API Scan object names?

options.text: Numeric names are mandatory for export.
They communicate intended sequence to reviewers; actual exported test-step order must still be checked.
Commander cannot import names containing letters.
Names cannot communicate any useful intent.

practiceQuiz.hint: Naming can help readability without scheduling execution.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Prefixes are independent readability guidance, not a documented export prerequisite or execution-order guarantee.

optionExplanations.A: The accessed docs do not require purely numeric names for export.
optionExplanations.B: Names can convey intent, while the actual execution sequence is configured separately.
optionExplanations.C: This unsupported restriction does not follow from the export workflow.
optionExplanations.D: Clear names can communicate purpose and sequence to reviewers.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which documented controls rename a selected API Scan project object?

options.text: Rename in the Home menu or the selected object context menu.
Only a keyboard shortcut; no menu exists.

practiceQuiz.hint: Use the commands explicitly named in current API Scan documentation.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The Home menu and project-object context menu provide Rename. The accessed pages do not verify the former F2 claim.

optionExplanations.A: These specific behaviors are not established by the accessed API Scan docs.
optionExplanations.B: Both documented menu routes can rename the selected object.
optionExplanations.C: The current docs explicitly describe Rename in menus.
optionExplanations.D: Self-dragging is not the documented rename command.

quickRecap.value: Save as chooses a filename; later Save/Ctrl+S saves the project to that file; Open and Close manage projects.
Duplicate/Delete target folders or messages; Rename is available in the Home menu and object context menu.
Save writes the current payload; Load or Add Files > Payload replaces existing payload content.
Preserve explicit checkpoints; automatic recovery and autosave behaviors are not certified here.
Project saving is distinct from exporting Commander artifacts or creating a subset.
Optional prefixes communicate intent; inspect actual TestCase order separately.
